title: Defender of Varrock
start: Talk to Captain Rovin, in the north-west tower of Varrock Palace.
prereq_other: Claim Kudos from Historian Minas in Varrock Museum for completing Shield of Arrav

items.t: Blurite ore (can be obtained during the quest from the ice cave near Thurgo)
Armour, weapons, and supplies to survive in the Wilderness

recommended.t: Activated Edgeville, Falador, Port Sarim and Varrock lodestones
Emergency teleport such as an ectophial, crystal teleport seed or a teleport tablet
A redberry pie, if you wish to gain an additional 1000 Smithing XP

rewards.t: Access to Chaos Temple Dungeon, where you can kill armoured zombies.
Access to four goldrune material caches
5 Kudos in Varrock Museum and a 1,000 experience antique lamp from Historian Minas on the floor 2 of the Museum.

steps.t: Dismiss any followers now.
Talk to Captain Rovin in Varrock Palace, on the floor 2 of north-west tower. [Chat: 1 Ooh, good, sounds like a quest. › Accept › 1 Okay, let's get going.]

sub.t: If he will not give you the quest, make sure you have claimed kudos from Historian Minas at Varrock Museum.

steps.t: Enter the Graveyard of Shadows, then talk to Hartwin. [Chat: 1 I want to talk about the mission.]

sub.t: Make sure Hartwin is following you in this section.
If you lose Hartwin for any reason, he can be found back at the Varrock Palace.

steps.t: Inspect the tree stump just south of the west graveyard entrance (just south of the arch) to uncover more footprints.
Follow the footprints and continue searching bushes, trees, stumps, mushrooms, and bones to uncover more footprints.

sub.t: Search the small forest of dead trees south of the Graveyard of Shadows, northwest of the Chaos Temple for a grubby key.

steps.t: The trail eventually leads to Simon near the Chaos Temple.
Run south to the trapdoor, unlock it using the grubby key and climb down.
Run north and look over the balcony.
Run west and take 3 bottles.
Kill 3 armoured zombies, using the bottles on red mist to fill them.
Proceed deeper into the cave through the door.
Run north and kill 3 armoured zombies again, using the bottles on red mist to fill them.
Go through the next door and look over another balcony.
Hartwin will give you a Varrock teleport tablet to return to Varrock quickly.
Return to Captain Rovin in Varrock.

Talk to Thurgo in Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim lodestone, north of fairy ring AIQ. [Chat: 3 I'd like to ask about the Shield of Arrav.] or [Chat: 4 I'd like to ask about the Shield of Arrav.] if you have 99 Smithing.

sub.t: If you don't have a blurite ore, now is the opportune time to mine one in the snowy area of the dungeon nearby.

steps.t: Climb Ice Mountain, west of Edgeville.
Dig with your spade 2 steps on Map | mapID=28 | x=3010 | y=3498 | text=the location | mtype=pin | type=maplink east of the white tree, next to the material caches, near the dungeon icon ().
Dig the churned-up snow then enter the hole.
Talk to Ramarno. [Chat: 4 I wish to use the Sacred Forge.]

sub.t: If you have a redberry pie, give it to Ramarno for 1,000 Smithing experience. [Chat: 1 Okay, here you go. › 4 I wish to use the Sacred Forge.]

steps.t: Use blurite ore on the forge.
Talk to Ramarno for a cutscene (note that pressing escape during the cutscene will reset it).
Return to Captain Rovin, ignoring the zombies. He gives you a restored shield.
Talk to Reldo in the library on the floor 1. [Chat: # I'd like to talk about the invading zombies.]
Read the Varrock Census on the lectern.
Search the scrolls on the floor a few steps south after talking to Reldo about the situation.
Read the list of elders.
Talk to the following NPCs until one mentions they are not a blood descendant:

sub.t: King Roald, southeast corner of the floor 1 [Chat: 1 Talk about Zombies.] or [Chat: 2 Talk about Zombies.] if the quest Lord of Vampyrium has been completed.
Aeonisig Raispher, next to King Roald. [Chat: 1 Defender of Varrock. › 1 Talk about the zombie invasion.]
Sir Prysin, west of the king.
Curator Haig Halen, in the Varrock Museum. [Chat: 1 Talk about the zombie invasion.]
Horvik the smith north-east of Varrock Square. [Chat: 2 Talk about the zombie invasion.]

steps.t: Talk to Dimintheis in south-east Varrock where you started the quest Family Crest. [Chat: 2 Ask about something else.]
Talk to Captain Rovin.
Quest complete!
